In today's technologically advanced world, there are a growing number of applications where
conventional machining techniques just aren't accurate enough to meet precision surfacing
requirements. Precision surfacing with abrasive media, a technology developed and refined by
LAPMASTER WOLTERS over the past 200 years, can often be the answer.

However, it takes more than the technology alone to produce precision surfacing and honing
specifications. It takes a company with extensive knowledge and experience with a broad range of
materials and applications.  A company capable of creating customized, turnkey precision surfacing
solutions utilizing the latest conventional and superabrasive grinding techniques...It takes
LAPMASTER WOLTERS, your partner in precision surfacing technology. We offer [Lapping
Machines][35], [Polishing Machines][36],[ Fine Grinding Machines][37], [Single Wafer &
SiC Processing Machines][38], Brush Deburring Machines, Creep Feed Grinding Machines, Double Disc
Grinding Machines, Buffing Machines in our ever growing product line.
